chamberGeometries.name: Y-Type Opposing Impinging Jet Diamond Chamber (F12Y, 75 µm Dual Micro-Channels)

chamberGeometries.description: Fluid stream splits into two opposing micro-jets that collide head-on at velocities up to 450 m/s inside a microscopic diamond cavitation zone, converting kinetic energy into pure shear and planar elongation without wall abrasion.

chamberGeometries.name: Z-Type High-Velocity Zigzag Impact Diamond Chamber (H30Z, 100 µm Slotted Channel)

chamberGeometries.optimalApplications: Insoluble Active Deagglomeration, Cell Lysis, Insoluble Fiber Size Reduction

chamberGeometries.name: Multi-Slotted Industrial Parallel Diamond Array (8 x 87 µm Parallel Channels)

emulsionFormulations.name: Curcumin & Phytosterol Lipophilic Nano-Emulsion (MCT Core, Sunflower Lecithin + Saponin)

emulsionFormulations.name: Omega-3 DHA / EPA Phospholipid Bilayer Liposome Suspension (Soy PC + Alpha-Tocopherol)
emulsionFormulations.description: Ultra-sensitive bioactive liposomes shielding polyunsaturated omega-3 fatty acids from oxidative rancidity. Demands low processing temperatures (<40°C) and uniform shear to generate unilamellar vesicles without lipid hydroperoxide formation.

emulsionFormulations.name: Vitamin D3 & Cold-Pressed Citrus Essential Oil Clear Beverage Nano-Dispersion

emulsionFormulations.surfactantSystem: Modified Gum Acacia (Arabic) + Polyoxyethylene Sorbitan Monooleate
emulsionFormulations.description: Optically transparent nano-dispersion engineered for continuous fortification of functional beverages without turbidity, ringing, or Phase separation over 12-month shelf life.

emulsionFormulations.name: Whey Protein Isolate & Casein Sub-Micellar Bioactive Carrier Complex
emulsionFormulations.coreLipid: Milk Fat Globule Membrane (MFGM) Lipid Matrix
emulsionFormulations.surfactantSystem: Native Micellar Casein Hydrolysate + Sodium Alginate
emulsionFormulations.description: Functional dairy protein nano-complex delivering native immunoglobulins. Requires gentle, controlled hydrodynamic shear to dissociate casein micelles into sub-micellar clusters without irreversible thermal denaturation of whey proteins.

coolingSystems.name: Passive Ambient Air-Cooled Finned Pipe Run (No Active Refrigeration, 25°C Ambient Air)
coolingSystems.classification: Inadequate / Unjacketed Cooling Run (High Thermal Accumulation Risk)
coolingSystems.thermalProtectionRating: CRITICAL RISK (Severe Lipid Peroxidation / Active Denaturation)
coolingSystems.description: Substandard passive air cooling that fails to dissipate viscous shear heat. Exit temperatures exceed 55°C after 2 passes, causing rapid destruction of heat-sensitive bioactive compounds.

coolingSystems.name: Fouled / Scale-Occluded Heat Exchanger (Calcified Tubes, Zero Heat Transfer)
coolingSystems.description: Severely fouled heat exchanger with calcified interior surfaces. Traps adiabatic shear heat inside the processed liquid, precipitating proteins and destroying liposomal bilayers.
